## Install

1. Download **`omarchy-web-theme-<version>.zip`** below and unzip it somewhere it can stay, like `~/.local/share/omarchy-web-theme`.
2. Open `chrome://extensions`, turn on **Developer mode**, click **Load unpacked**, and pick the unzipped folder.
3. Click **Details** on the extension and turn on **Allow access to file URLs**.
4. Reload your open tabs.

Pages now follow your Omarchy theme, and switch with it live.

The `-store.zip` is the same extension without the fixed ID, for the Chrome Web Store.
